title: LOGO DISPLAY ISSUE IN 3D TAB
content:
![c42c537d41a5455ea8e58db76dbf243e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/edba58eaead0408d8368b5446faceebf/images/c42c537d41a5455ea8e58db76dbf243eScreenshot%202025-08-09%20125212.jpg)when i download that file from closet connect offical and open in clo 3d the logo is showing in 2d tab in pattern but not showing in 3d tab ? can some one tell me how logo show in t-shirt in 3d tab

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hellow - Check Placement:Click on Graphic , On the Property editor , Graphic Configuration you will see FACE . Be sure put it in FRONT Sometimes it’s on the wrong side of the fabric and you just can’t see it in 3D.- Opacity Issue:Select the fabric where the graphic is applied → In Property Editor, check Texture Map slots. If the fabric has an Opacity Map or Graphic Opacity set to 0%, the logo will be invisible in 3D.And know that sometimes when you download an asset from CLO-SET, sometimes the graphic isn’t embedded—it’s just a reference link. Right-click the graphic → Change Graphic → Re-import the image file manually.

Comment 2: Hi There. Looks like you may have installed an unofficial version of CLO. We would first recommend subscribing and downloading CLO directly from our website. This will likely solve many issues and allow you to update to CLO 2025
content_description: This webpage provides guidance on how to display logos on T-shirts in the 3D view of CLO 3D after importing pattern files.

title: Bloom & Breeze – Fashion in the Fields 🌸🌿
content:
🌸✨ There’s something magical about watching clothes dance in the breeze. For this piece, I wanted to capture that in-between moment – when garments aren’t on the runway yet, but are already alive. Each piece was digitally crafted in CLO3D, then placed in a sunny daisy field where nature takes over as the ultimate stylist.  
It’s a reminder that fashion doesn’t just live on bodies – it lives in the air, in the light, and in the stories we imagine while it moves.

![0d5a93d6a9f8486b8d6eeb6d0864b4ed](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/1957d8a7ebe6455fa93f576e3a57dbb1/images/0d5a93d6a9f8486b8d6eeb6d0864b4ed10569.png)![26e83f34c6a64e5899eec1a7c1366e10](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/1957d8a7ebe6455fa93f576e3a57dbb1/images/26e83f34c6a64e5899eec1a7c1366e1010149.png)![4795f85220924c828e137d39a6f2c6eb](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/1957d8a7ebe6455fa93f576e3a57dbb1/images/4795f85220924c828e137d39a6f2c6eb20048.png)![08b0cd9b135b496d9d4950f815d40c13](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/1957d8a7ebe6455fa93f576e3a57dbb1/images/08b0cd9b135b496d9d4950f815d40c1320175.png)![9746f3813d9c47519cb8bb285647c5e0](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/1957d8a7ebe6455fa93f576e3a57dbb1/images/9746f3813d9c47519cb8bb285647c5e020594.png)
